methods.label: Interpret the nine-state counting system
methods.explanation:
Each wheel cycles through the nine symbols \(0,1,2,3,5,6,7,8,9\) before carrying to the next wheel. Relabeling these symbols as \(0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8\) therefore turns the odometer into an ordinary base-nine counter: nine advances in one position produce one advance in the next position.

The displayed \(2\) still represents \(2\), while the displayed \(5\) represents \(4\), since it is four advances after \(0\). Thus the reading \(002005\) corresponds to \((2004)_9\). The place values for actual miles are \(1,9,9^2,9^3,\ldots\), so the mileage is
\[(2004)_9=2\cdot9^3+4=1458+4=1462.\]
The zero reading represents zero miles, so no extra mile is added for the initial reading. The car has traveled \(1462\) miles, choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
